name: Entity Reference Formatter Access Bypass
description: An entity-reference field formatter that renders referenced entities the viewer cannot normally view, falling back to an administrator-chosen view mode instead of hiding them.
project_description: The Entity Reference Formatter Access Bypass module extends the core rendered-entity reference formatter and lets a site builder pick a fallback view mode used when the current user cannot access a referenced entity. By default, core hides referenced entities the user cannot view; with this formatter the entity is instead rendered in the chosen fallback view mode so a limited or anonymous user can still be shown the fields the site builder placed in that fallback view mode. Configuration: on Manage display for an entity reference field, choose the 'Rendered entity with access bypass fallback' formatter and configure both the default view mode and the fallback view mode.
